tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. Dark and Night are true black so OLED pixels are off.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The board, cards, list groups and the hint card, on `bg`. At night it equals `bg`: nothing is lit behind text.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline of every `surface` shape. Invisible in Light and Dark (same as `surface`); at night it is the only thing that draws a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Given digits, titles and body copy on `bg` and `surface`. 18:1 Light, 16:1 Dark, 7.4:1 Night.

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, pencil notes, key counts and inactive tab labels on `bg` and `surface`. At least 4.7:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Entered digits, hint rings, the active tab and tool, and secondary button labels, on `bg` and `surface`. At least 4.8:1 in every theme. At night it is a redder amber than `ink`; weight, not hue, separates entered from given.

tokens.name: btn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button. Black at night: the button becomes an outline.

tokens.name: btn-ink
tokens.usage: Label of the primary button, on `btn-bg`. 5.4:1 Light, 9:1 Dark, 5.7:1 Night.

tokens.name: btn-edge
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of the primary button. Only visible at night.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the secondary button and of the selected segment, with an `accent` or `ink` label. Clear at night.

tokens.name: fill-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline of anything filled with `fill`. Only visible at night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Cell lines inside the board, list separators and the unfilled part of rings and sliders.

tokens.name: line-major
tokens.usage: The 2px lines between 3×3 boxes. At least 3:1 on `surface` in every theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Tint behind the unit a hint points at (one box, row or column). Cells only, never a large area.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: A wrong digit and the bar under it, on `surface`. Always with the bar; never colour alone.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of floating controls (tab bar, tool bar, keypad, round buttons), with a 22px backdrop blur. Clear at night.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline of every glass control.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: The selected tab's pill inside the tab bar.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: The Night theme's ink as a fixed colour, for showing Night outside the Night theme: the appearance picker's preview and the cover.

tokens.name: icon-bg
tokens.usage: App icon background. The icon colours are the same in every theme.

tokens.name: icon-block
tokens.usage: App icon: the four solved cells.

tokens.name: icon-proof
tokens.usage: App icon: the two proof cells.

tokens.name: icon-empty
tokens.usage: App icon: the two empty cells.

tokens.name: icon-answer
tokens.usage: App icon: the answer cell.

tokens.name: icon-digit
tokens.usage: App icon: the 5 on `icon-answer`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The large title on Home, Learn and Journal.

styles.name: level
styles.usage: A level name on the Continue card and in a lesson header.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Technique names, the hint title and the game's navigation title.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: The first line of a list row.

styles.name: digit-given
styles.usage: Given digits on the board, in `ink`, tabular numerals.

styles.name: digit-entered
styles.usage: Digits the player entered, in `accent`, tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Row 4, row 6 and column 1 each already hold a 5.
styles.usage: Hint and lesson copy, row subtitles at 13px use `label`.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Secondary lines and section labels, in `ink2`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tab and tool labels, and the count under each key.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Pencil notes inside a cell, in `ink2`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its body inside a card.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, and between the tool bar and the keypad.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inset of the bottom controls from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inset of the tab bar from the left, right and bottom edges.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above a section label.

tokens.name: r-ring
tokens.usage: Hint rings inside a cell.

tokens.name: r-board
tokens.usage: The board.

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: The hint card and buttons (a 44px button is a pill at this radius).

tokens.name: r-group
tokens.usage: List groups, the Continue card, the tool bar and the keypad.

tokens.name: r-bar
tokens.usage: The tab bar and the round button beside it (half their 62px height).

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Under every glass control. None at night.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit target.

tokens.name: board-w
tokens.usage: Board width on a 390pt screen: 6pt from each edge.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: One cell at `board-w`.

tokens.name: tools-h
tokens.usage: Height of the tool bar.

tokens.name: key-h
tokens.usage: Height of the keypad.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the tab bar.
